_README: Security advisory allowlist for spec 002 / FR-031.
WARNING: Adding an entry here weakens the CI security gate.
Every entry MUST carry a non-empty 'justification' so reviewers
can challenge it in PR review. Stale entries (allowlisted
advisory no longer in the dependency audit output) trip the gate
with exit code 3 — that is a feature, not a bug: it forces the
allowlist to stay clean as deps churn.
"justification": "<why this is acceptable, e.g. 'false positive — the vulnerable code path is unreachable from the extension entrypoint'>",

allowed.justification: jsonpath-plus RCE — transitive via @kubernetes/client-node>request. JSONPath in this codepath only ever consumes responses from the user's OWN trusted Kubernetes API server (cluster discovery + Secret reads), never attacker-controlled JSON. Out-of-process exploitation surface = none. Upstream fix gated on @kubernetes/client-node major upgrade (0.21 -> 1.x); tracked as a follow-up after the public Marketplace release ships.
jsonpath-plus RCE (second CVE for the same library) — same justification as advisory 1102423; same upstream fix path.

form-data unsafe boundary RNG — transitive via @kubernetes/client-node>request. Relevant only for multipart/form-data uploads, which the extension does not perform (k8s API calls are all JSON via the typed client; SPDY port-forward upgrade negotiation does not use multipart). Same upstream fix path as the jsonpath-plus advisories.
